mapper.sql: case when o.recipient_type = 0 then (select s2.name from staff s2 where s2.id = o.recipient_id) when o.recipient_type = 1 then (select e.name from elder e where e.id = o.recipient_id) end as recipient_name
mapper.insert: insert into outbound_record(warehouse_id, staff_id, recipient_id, recipient_type, material_use, outbound_time, status, del_flag, create_by, remark, create_time) values (#{warehouseId}, #{staffId}, #{recipientId}, #{recipientType}, #{materialUse}, #{outboundTime}, #{status}, 0, #{createBy}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from outbound_record where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0

select o.*, w.name as warehouse_name, s.name as staff_name,
from outbound_record o left join warehouse w on o.warehouse_id = w.id left join staff s on o.staff_id = s.id where o.id = #{id} and o.del_flag = 0
